3 Navigate the Risk Phase ▼

After the offer, this is where deals fall apart. Here's how we protect your equity.

  • Pre-inspection.
  • Agent meets the inspector live.
  • Appraisal beforehand if needed.
  • We brief the appraiser on upgrades.
  • We stay close to the buyer's lender.
4 The 3 Types of Pricing ▼

Three pricing strategies. Three different outcomes.

👆 Drag the ball or tap a label to reveal each one.
Aspirational $$
Market Value
Event Based

Aspirational Pricing

“I'll list high and come down if needed.”

Most sellers go straight to the top. Makes sense. But this only works if the home is one-of-a-kind. For most homes it kills momentum and trains buyers to wait you out.

Market Value Pricing

A fair price, right where everyone else is.

Some sellers list right where everyone else is. It works. But your home becomes one of 15 to 20 listings. You're hoping yours gets picked.

Event-Based Pricing

Almost no seller does this. That's exactly why it works.

Most sellers chase a bigger number and miss. Event pricing (think auction style) pulls every serious buyer to your home first. You get noticed. You get prioritized.

5 The 10-5-0 Rule (How We Adjust) ▼

The 10-5-0 Rule

6%
No showings. Adjust the invitation price by 6%.
4%
Less than 10 showings in 10 days & no offers. Adjust by 4%.
2%
10+ showings but fewer than 5 offers. Adjust by 2%.

2 The Real Job of an Agent ▼

Under contract is where the real work starts.

A great Realtor pulls all three contracts together so the result lands on your price, terms, and timeline.

3 Who's Who. The Power Players. ▼

Everyone on this list has to be managed so the deal doesn't fall through. That's my job.

Buyer. Qualified.
Buyer's Agent. Handles offer and negotiations.
Seller. That's you.
Seller's Broker. Real Brokerage. Keeps it compliant.
Lender. Approves the buyer's financing.
Inspector. Checks condition, flags issues.
Appraiser. Sets the value for the lender.
Title Company. Verifies ownership, issues insurance.
Escrow. Handles money and paperwork.
Attorneys. When needed.
10TERMS
The Investment
Time frame, closing costs, and how I get paid.
▼
1 Time Frame ▼

Most agents lock you in for 6 months. We ask for 4.

If life changes, easy exit. You just cover any upfront costs.

2 Closing Costs ▼

Total closing costs (buyer + seller) average 7%-9% of the sales price.

My fee is already inside that number. Nothing hidden on top.

3 My Fee ▼

I only get paid when the job's done.

The higher we sell, the more I earn. Fully aligned.

4 Flexible Commission Plan ▼

If I don't deliver, I work for free. My fee scales with performance:

6%
Under contract in the first 30 days.
5%
After the first 30 days.
4%
After four months.
